newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Goldtron pays S$19.2 mln for Guthrie stock.
newsitem.headline: Goldtron pays S$19.2 mln for Guthrie stock.

text.p: Electronics manufacturer Goldtron Ltd said on Tuesday it paid Singapore $19.2 million for 32 million shares in Guthrie Ltd.

Goldtron said in a statement it paid S$0.60 cents each the shares in Guthrie, a diversified company. The purchase, which would be financed internally, represented approximately 4.83 per cent of Guthrie's total issued and paid-up capital, it said.
The transaction was not expected to have any significant effect on the net tangible assets or earnings of the Goldtron Group for the financial year ended December 31 this year.
